text:
sara: Heads up — noticed a spike in handoff failures for EMEA leads this morning. HubSpot -> SF sync lagging (~2m) and RR sometimes assigns to a stale owner. Seen in /hs-sync/errors. Anyone else seeing this? :warning:
devon: saw a couple alerts. is this before enrichment or after? any sample event?
sara: here's one sample payload (redacted):
```json
{"hs_contact_id":"12345","enrichment_status":"timeout","assigned_owner":"u_904","created_at":"2026-03-23T08:12:01Z","hs_to_sf_sync_delay_s":125}
```
aj: quick scan — enrichment timed out at ~8s, fallback to default owner didn't trigger. looks like the boolean flag in the RR pipeline is inverted: `allow_fallback=false` when enrichment fails. saw similar in a rollback two weeks ago.
maria: i can patch the enrichment TTL to 12s and flip the fallback flag. plan: canary target=marketing workspace for 30m then widen. @sara can you confirm business owners okay with temporary owner flip? :thumbsup:
suresh: we should also add a cheap gate in the round-robin assigner: if `owner_last_seen_ms > 300000` then skip and push to overflow queue. i'll add a feature flag `rr_staleness_gate` so we can toggle.
automations-bot: Deploy started: `hs-enrichment-ttl-bump` canary -> marketing at 1768906332 by maria. Link: https://deploys.redwood/1768906332
sara: thanks — please post canary metrics (handoff success rate, hs->sf lag) after 30m. also can we add an alert: `hs_sf_sync_latency > 45s` -> page weekdays 9-5 PT? want to avoid silent degradation.
devon: action items summarized: 1) patch TTL to 12s (maria) 2) enable fallback flag (maria) 3) add RR circuit-breaker for staleness (suresh) 4) create alert + paging (devon) 5) update inbound handoff playbook with canary steps (devon). I'll own the rollout doc and post the playbook snippet here.
sara: solid. if canary looks good i'll roll to EMEA and APAC lanes. thanks team. :raised_hands:
